en.heading: Precise Location
points: Where exactly will our boat be moored?

How far is the nearest medical facility from our location?

en.heading: River and Forest Activities
points: What river activities are confirmed for this trip?
Which forest walks are part of the schedule?

en.heading: Guiding and Comfort
points: How many guides will accompany our group?
What type of sleeping arrangements are provided?
Is hot water available for showers?

en.heading: Excursion Time
points: How many hours per day are spent on the river?

When do we arrive at the next stop?

en.heading: Complete Transfer Plan
points: Where will our vehicle pick us up from?
How long does the transfer to the port take?
Is there a backup plan if the boat is delayed?

en.heading: Written Proposals
points: Can you send a written confirmation of all services?

Where can I find the signed contract details?

¿Qué campamento específico está incluido en el itinerario?
¿A qué distancia se encuentra la instalación médica más cercana de nuestra ubicación?

points: ¿Qué actividades fluviales están confirmadas para este viaje?

points: ¿Cuántos guías acompañarán a nuestro grupo?

points: ¿Dónde recogerá nuestro vehículo al grupo?

es.heading: Propuestas Escritas
points: ¿Puede enviar una confirmación escrita de todos los servicios?
¿Qué está incluido exactamente en el precio?
